description: This file contains implementation of DM-RS (Demodulation Reference Signal) helper functions for 3GPP NR (New Radio) specifications, including pattern definitions, sequence generation, and parameter retrieval based on DMRS type and port.

methods.name: dmrs_sequence_generate
methods.description: Generates DM-RS sequence based on resource block mask, PRG, amplitude, reference point, and DMRS per resource block.

methods.name: get_pxsch_dmrs_params
methods.description: Retrieves the physical resource block scrambling parameters for a given DMRS type and port.
